Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). That file is the only playbook for bootstrapping and changing this WSL workstation.

You are often on a Windows 11 work laptop with no Linux toolchain yet. Detect Windows vs WSL first. Git Bash is Windows, not Linux. On Windows, run `windows/bootstrap.ps1` (existing laptop: `wsl --update`, Ubuntu 26.04 if missing, leave leftover 24.04/Store Ubuntu installed, NOPASSWD sudo for the existing user, Terminal `wsl`/`ubuntu` profiles, then `install.sh` inside the distro). If you are already inside `Ubuntu-24.04` or Store `Ubuntu`, do not run `install.sh` and do not `wsl --unregister` — run `bootstrap.ps1` from Windows PowerShell instead. Do not use cloud-init. Do not invent a second installer. At work, Copilot is the operator — do not tell the user to run Grok or Claude.
